description: Périmètre des stations de traitement des eaux usées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Large-scale localisation, in the form of a layer of polygons, of treatment plants (steps) and other wastewater treatment plants, with their main information. This layer concerns the entire department of Loir-et-Cher. The polygons delineate the complete right-of-way of the installation. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Perimeter of wastewater treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2015-04-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
